_doc: Map 4 'Fernflug' Act II: der Kranich, in flight (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md §4, DECISIONS T-108/T-109). map_key: the story-prop / intel key. act: the act block (RoundManager: rounds are ACT-RELATIVE here, act round n = match round - act_start + 1, so 'ACT II · 1' is match round 15 in a campaign run and match round 1 when the act is played on its own; every round in this block and in `flight` is an act round). special_kind: the special round this act runs; boss: the Bordwart, reserved on act round 4 (match 18); events: the London window at act round 3 (match 17) and the bomb run at act round 5 (match 19) (the round clock's versions; the main egg's steps can fire them earlier); autopilot_fallback_round: at act round 6 the cockpit door's key requirement is cleared and the key laid on the engineer's station if the Bordwart was never fought. power: the auxiliary bus in the centre body (the wing's own power is the impellers; the squad can only light the deck, the Crucible and the cockpit door). flight: the set-pieces (gravelight/world/map04/flight_controller.gd): turbulence, strafing, breaches, climbers, Druckabfall, the bomb run. exfil: the autopilot cradle on the flight deck (Act II → Act III): needs the autopilot key, a first 'unlock' stage, then the 6 s 'rip it out' hold which is the vote; lit on act round 6 (`act_round`; `round` 20 is the nominal match round for the validators) or by the egg's step (flag autopilot_now).

spawn_table._doc: windows = the inspection hatches (the closets outside the hull are where the dead cling on); ground = emerge points (the ramp seam, the bunks' floor hatch, the engine room's floor); catwalk = the blister rims in E_KANZEL (the climbers' way in; Catwalk_E_KANZEL_n).

flight._doc: The Kranich's set-pieces. turbulence: every interval_min..max s the Bordfunk warns warn_seconds ahead, then the deck banks: a lateral push of push_mps for seconds on everyone (Player/Zombie.external_push; Skyhook's push_resist applies), the camera rolls roll_deg, zombies stagger stagger_seconds at the onset, bots brace. strafe: from act round from_act_round (act-relative), every every_rounds_min..max rounds, lines tracer lines rake one of `zones` (never B or F): a width m wide line of dps for seconds, telegraphed by sparks lead_seconds ahead; it kills zombies too. breach: a panel blows on its own every panel_interval_min..max s from from_act_round (or when a strafe line crosses it): suction_mps toward it within radius for seconds, zombies pulled through die (returned_kill Scrip to nobody), sealed by a seal_hold s hold or on its own; an open breach is a climb entry. climbers: the Bordschützen (enemies.json bordschuetze) rise at the blister rims (E_KANZEL's catwalk spawns) and open breaches, every climber_interval s while zombies are queued. druckabfall: the special round: every panel blows in sequence (panel_gap s apart), climbers replace the window spawns, a Resupply on the clear. bomb_run: the racks (Rack1..6, rack_index order), rack_interval s between drops (solo_rack_interval solo), rack 1 always drops, duds from 2..6 seeded per match, flags bomb_<city>.
